description:
Using his Almighty Farming Tool, Hiraku Machio continues transforming his village into an even livelier community as new residents from across the region find refuge there. As he tends the fields that first brought everyone together, Hiraku gradually takes on a greater role by guiding the village's growth not only as the chief but also as a father, ensuring that each day counts.

(Source: MAL Rewrite)

Note: World premiere of Episode 1 before the Japanese television premiere occurred at ANIMONIUM in Bangkok February 8, 2026

alternative: Loo Lulucy (ルールーシー＝ルー)

node.description: __Race:__ Vampire __Affiliation:__ Taiju Village, Kingdom of Galbart (Formerly) Loo is a Female Vampire, who stumbles into Hiraku's farm during his early days of living in the formidable forest of death. On the run, with no where to turn, she falls in love with Hiraku who by this time has not seen another person since coming to the world. She can change her body/age to suit her needs to survive. She is a skilled magician as well as a farmer who works at Hiraku's farm. At first she viewed Hiraku's farm (now a village) as a place she can hide from the nobles and now she views it as home. ~!She and Hiraku had a kid named Alfred.!~

**Race:** Angel Tier is one of the main characters of Isekai Nonbiri Nouka series. She is an angel with celestial magical powers and bird-like wings that allow her to fly. She is part of the Angel of Annihilation tribe, specializing in golem magic. Tier visits the forest in search of Loo, her frenemy, and ends up living there with Hiraku and Loo.

Zabuton is a giant demon spider who came to Hiraku's farm. With the offer of being able to provide Hiraku a source of clothes in exchange for making a home in his giant tree that dominates the center of his farm. Zabuton acts as the main seamstress and lookout for the farm and later village. She also has many offspring who aid the village.

**Race:** Human Hiraku Machio is the main protagonist of Isekai Nonbiri Nouka series. He was resurrected with a healthy body, the ability to speak the common tongue, and the All-Purpose Farming Tool (AFT) by God. Despite being unable to use magic, he cultivates the forest to create farmland and a village, with the help of the wolves Kuro and Yuki, the demon spider Zabuton, and even humanoid species.

**Race:** Beastman Senna is the leader and representative of the Beastmen immigrants who migrated from Howling Village to Hiraku's village. She is also the daughter of the former chief of Howling Village.

**Race:** High Elf Ria is the leader of a group of high-elf girls who wandered in the forest after their village was destroyed by humans in a war. They were homeless for 200 years until Tier brought them to Hiraku's farm. Ria is a reliable construction enthusiast and contributes to the farm by establishing a smithy and bringing other technologies such as building construction and baking. After meeting Hiraku and his friends, Ria decides to live with them.
**Race:** Dragon Rasutisumoon is the daughter of Doraim and Graffaloon, who requested her to serve as a diplomat in Hiraku's village. She later takes charge of the village's diplomatic relations.

alternative: Ancient Dragon (エンシェントドラゴン)

node.description: **Race:** Dragon Hakuren is the older sister of Doraim and Rasuti's aunt. She initially attacks the village upon hearing that her niece, Rasuti, has a boyfriend, but is eventually repelled by Hiraku and decides to settle down in the village.

**Race:** Vampire Flora is a skilled witch who arrived at Hiraku's house searching for Loo. She is also a researcher interested in fermentation, which led her to move to the village. She contributed to the farm by introducing the first two heads of cattle and her knowledge of potion making.
**Race:** Oni Ann is an Oni and represents the Oni Maids who now live in the village with Flora. Formerly working for Loo and Flora, she now also looks after Hiraku and his family in the forest.

Fraurem Chrome is a demon and daughter of Demon King advisor, Bizel Chrome, she is hard working girl. She was sent to Taiju Village by her father as his representative. Originally thought to be spy, she turned out to be normal resident.

Doraim is the dragon tribe's leader. Royalty and defender of his domain which lies south of the Taiju Village in the western mountains. His lands, acts as a defensive post for civilization, since its situated between the Forest of Death & the lesser known Iron Forest. 
While a powerful being, his personality quite a normal being, with taste for drink (such as the Taiju Village in particular). After the defeat of the rare firebreathing wild Wyvern at the hands of Hiraku Machio, he felt such a being must be befriended (he also fears). After becoming fast friends, and discovering the fantastic food & drink the village had to offer. His personal assistant Guchi, must drag him back to his duties as the Gate Keeper in the mountains or he would never leave.

He was such a frequent visitor his own daughter, Lastismun, became gravely concern that he was cheating on his wife, Graffalun, only to find he was over indulging at the Taiju Village, now having a guest home.

After his daughter, attempted to attack the village, he ordered her to remain there to get better acquainted with them and cool down her temper.

Yuuri is a demon and the daughter of the current reigning demon king, Gargard. She holds the rank of Princess. She is considered to be the most important ranking member of the royal family (She is not the heir, since Demon Kings are appointed). Like all Demons, she has incredible magical powers.
A white dragon who is Doraim's wife and Rasutisumoon's mother.
